::: {.book-summary} ## Book Summary Insight Job explores the mystery of suffering, the sovereignty of God, and the limits of human understanding. The book teaches that God's wisdom and purposes transcend human comprehension and remain worthy of trust. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 1
Job 1:21
The LORD gave, and the LORD hath taken away
### Why This Verse Job's response to loss ### Chapter Insight This chapter introduces Job's righteousness and his sudden suffering. The key verse demonstrates unwavering worship despite devastating loss. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 2
Job 2:10
Shall we receive good and not evil?
### Why This Verse Job's perseverance ### Chapter Insight This chapter records Job's physical affliction and continued faithfulness. The key verse highlights perseverance when suffering intensifies. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 3
Job 3:3
Let the day perish wherein I was born
### Why This Verse Beginning of Job's lament ### Chapter Insight This chapter contains Job's lament over his suffering. The key verse expresses the depth of human anguish and confusion. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 4
Job 4:8
They that plow iniquity reap the same
### Why This Verse Eliphaz's theology ### Chapter Insight This chapter begins Eliphaz's first speech. The key verse reflects the mistaken belief that suffering is always the result of personal sin. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 5
Job 5:17
Happy is the man whom God correcteth
### Why This Verse Later quoted in Hebrews ### Chapter Insight This chapter continues Eliphaz's counsel. The key verse emphasizes God's discipline, though applied incorrectly to Job's situation. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 6
Job 6:24
Teach me, and I will hold my tongue
### Why This Verse Job seeks understanding ### Chapter Insight This chapter records Job's response to Eliphaz. The key verse reveals Job's desire for understanding and compassion amid suffering. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 7
Job 7:17
What is man, that Thou shouldest magnify him?
### Why This Verse Famous reflection on humanity ### Chapter Insight This chapter expresses Job's weariness and questions. The key verse highlights the brevity and difficulty of life. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 8
Job 8:7
Though thy beginning was small
### Why This Verse Frequently quoted encouragement ### Chapter Insight This chapter contains Bildad's first speech. The key verse reflects confidence in traditional wisdom while misunderstanding Job's circumstances. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 9
Job 9:2
How should man be just with God?
### Why This Verse Central theological question ### Chapter Insight This chapter records Job's recognition of God's greatness. The key verse expresses humanity's need for a mediator before God. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 10
Job 10:12
Thou hast granted me life and favor
### Why This Verse Job recalls God's care ### Chapter Insight This chapter continues Job's plea for understanding. The key verse reveals his struggle to reconcile suffering with God's purposes. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 11
Job 11:7
Canst thou by searching find out God?
### Why This Verse Zophar's challenge ### Chapter Insight This chapter contains Zophar's first speech. The key verse demonstrates the limitations of human understanding about God's ways. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 12
Job 12:13
With Him are wisdom and strength
### Why This Verse God's sovereignty ### Chapter Insight This chapter begins Job's response to his friends. The key verse affirms God's sovereignty over all creation. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 13
Job 13:15
Though He slay me, yet will I trust Him
### Why This Verse One of Job's most quoted verses ### Chapter Insight This chapter records Job's determination to trust God. The key verse expresses remarkable faith despite uncertainty. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 14
Job 14:14
If a man die, shall he live again?
### Why This Verse Hope beyond death ### Chapter Insight This chapter reflects on the frailty of human life. The key verse expresses hope beyond death. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 15
Job 15:35
They conceive mischief and bring forth vanity
### Why This Verse Eliphaz's accusation ### Chapter Insight This chapter contains Eliphaz's second speech. The key verse continues the argument that suffering proves guilt. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 16
Job 16:19
My witness is in heaven
### Why This Verse Job's appeal ### Chapter Insight This chapter records Job's complaint against his friends. The key verse reveals his longing for an advocate in heaven. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 17
Job 17:9
The righteous shall hold on his way
### Why This Verse Perseverance ### Chapter Insight This chapter expresses Job's discouragement. The key verse highlights the struggle to maintain hope amid despair. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 18
Job 18:21
Such are the dwellings of the wicked
### Why This Verse Bildad's conclusion ### Chapter Insight This chapter contains Bildad's second speech. The key verse reflects his conviction that the wicked inevitably suffer judgment. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 19
Job 19:25
I know that my Redeemer liveth
### Why This Verse Most famous verse in Job ### Chapter Insight This chapter records Job's declaration of faith. The key verse expresses hope in a living Redeemer despite present suffering. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 20
Job 20:5
The triumphing of the wicked is short
### Why This Verse Zophar's argument ### Chapter Insight This chapter contains Zophar's second speech. The key verse emphasizes the temporary nature of wicked prosperity. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 21
Job 21:7
Why do the wicked live?
### Why This Verse Job challenges conventional wisdom ### Chapter Insight This chapter challenges simplistic views of suffering. The key verse observes that the wicked often prosper despite their rebellion. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 22
Job 22:21
Acquaint now thyself with Him, and be at peace
### Why This Verse Widely quoted counsel ### Chapter Insight This chapter contains Eliphaz's final speech. The key verse urges repentance, though wrongly assuming Job's guilt. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 23
Job 23:10
When He has tried me, I shall come forth as gold
### Why This Verse Classic faith-under-trial verse ### Chapter Insight This chapter records Job's longing to present his case before God. The key verse expresses confidence in God's ultimate vindication. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 24
Job 24:1
Why are times not hidden from the Almighty?
### Why This Verse Justice questioned ### Chapter Insight This chapter wrestles with apparent injustice in the world. The key verse questions why evil often goes unpunished. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 25
Job 25:6
Man is a worm
### Why This Verse Bildad's humility theme ### Chapter Insight This chapter contains Bildad's final remarks. The key verse emphasizes God's holiness and human weakness. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 26
Job 26:7
He hangs the earth upon nothing
### Why This Verse Frequently cited scientific-sounding statement ### Chapter Insight This chapter celebrates God's majesty in creation. The key verse highlights the vastness of God's power beyond human comprehension. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 27
Job 27:5
Till I die I will not remove mine integrity
### Why This Verse Job's resolve ### Chapter Insight This chapter records Job's continued defense of his integrity. The key verse demonstrates his commitment to righteousness. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 28
Job 28:28
The fear of the Lord, that is wisdom
### Why This Verse One of Job's great themes ### Chapter Insight This chapter reflects on the nature of true wisdom. The key verse identifies reverence for God as the source of wisdom. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 29
Job 29:14
I put on righteousness
### Why This Verse Job remembers former honor ### Chapter Insight This chapter recalls Job's former blessings and influence. The key verse highlights the respect and honor he once enjoyed. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 30
Job 30:20
I cry unto Thee, and Thou dost not hear
### Why This Verse Job's anguish ### Chapter Insight This chapter contrasts Job's past honor with present suffering. The key verse expresses the depth of his humiliation. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 31
Job 31:1
I made a covenant with mine eyes
### Why This Verse Frequently quoted purity verse ### Chapter Insight This chapter presents Job's final defense. The key verse demonstrates his commitment to personal integrity before God. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 32
Job 32:8
There is a spirit in man
### Why This Verse Elihu begins speaking ### Chapter Insight This chapter introduces Elihu. The key verse highlights the importance of speaking with humility and discernment. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 33
Job 33:4
The Spirit of God hath made me
### Why This Verse Creation and life ### Chapter Insight This chapter contains Elihu's appeal to Job. The key verse emphasizes God's desire to communicate and redeem. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 34
Job 34:10
Far be it from God to do wickedness
### Why This Verse Elihu on divine justice ### Chapter Insight This chapter defends God's justice. The key verse affirms that God always acts righteously. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 35
Job 35:10
Where is God my Maker?
### Why This Verse Seeking God in suffering ### Chapter Insight This chapter discusses human righteousness and God's transcendence. The key verse highlights God's independence from human actions. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 36
Job 36:26
God is great, and we know Him not
### Why This Verse Divine transcendence ### Chapter Insight This chapter continues Elihu's defense of God's ways. The key verse emphasizes God's greatness and wisdom. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 37
Job 37:14
Stand still and consider the wondrous works of God
### Why This Verse Preparation for God's appearance ### Chapter Insight This chapter points to God's majesty in nature. The key verse prepares the reader for God's direct response. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 38
Job 38:4
Where wast thou when I laid the foundations of the earth?
### Why This Verse God's first challenge ### Chapter Insight This chapter begins God's answer from the whirlwind. The key verse demonstrates the limits of human understanding compared to God's wisdom. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 39
Job 39:19
Hast thou given the horse strength?
### Why This Verse God's wisdom in creation ### Chapter Insight This chapter continues God's questions concerning creation. The key verse emphasizes God's care and governance over all creatures. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 40
Job 40:4
Behold, I am vile; what shall I answer Thee?
### Why This Verse Job's humility ### Chapter Insight This chapter calls Job to humility before God. The key verse highlights the inadequacy of challenging God's wisdom. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 41
Job 41:1
Canst thou draw out Leviathan?
### Why This Verse Famous Leviathan passage ### Chapter Insight This chapter describes Leviathan. The key verse demonstrates God's unmatched power over forces beyond human control. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 42
Job 42:5
I have heard of Thee, but now mine eye seeth Thee
### Why This Verse Job's final realization ### Chapter Insight This chapter records Job's repentance, restoration, and vindication. The key verse reveals true wisdom through humility before God. :::
